title: Eco Board Buying Guide
summary: Plan partitions, display surfaces, ceiling accents, and interior panels with clearer quoting details.
body: Eco Board works best when the Ramani team understands the space, finish expectation, approximate area, and installation timeline. Share the number of rooms or surfaces, the intended use, and the delivery location so the team can help convert your idea into a practical materials list.

title: Glass Craft and Recycling Sourcing Guide
summary: Match sorted glass supply to reuse, craft, decor, and sustainable construction projects.
body: Glass needs vary by sorting, handling, volume, and intended use. For craft or decor projects, describe the finish and project size. For recycling or industrial reuse, share batch expectations and collection or delivery timing so Ramani can guide the right quote path.

title: PPR Plumbing Planning Guide
summary: Prepare the right details before requesting pipes, fittings, and water-system support.
body: PPR enquiries should include the project type, approximate pipe runs, fitting needs, and urgency. The estimator can suggest a starting list, but Ramani should confirm specifications before final supply because plumbing needs depend on site conditions.

title: Interior Fit-Out Sourcing Guide
summary: Turn office, retail, hospitality, and display-space ideas into a quote-ready brief.
body: Interior projects move faster when the scope is clear. Share the space type, approximate area, finish direction, budget range, timeline, and any must-have materials. Ramani can then guide products, packages, and consultation next steps.

title: Cleaning Operations Supply Guide
summary: Choose detergent and grease solutions by facility type, frequency, and pack requirements.
body: Cleaning supply needs depend on the facility, surface type, cleaning frequency, and storage preference. Share whether the product is for a workshop, hospitality backroom, food-handling zone, warehouse, or general facility use so Ramani can recommend a suitable supply path.

title: Furniture Sourcing Guide
summary: Plan furniture orders by room type, quantity, finish, delivery area, and customization needs.
body: Furniture sourcing is smoother when quantity, room type, finish preference, delivery area, and timeline are clear. Standard and custom pieces should move through quote follow-up so finish, quantity, delivery area, and timeline can be confirmed.
